name: HUIJU-nm
title: Multilayer ceramic chip capacitors, C0G and X7R, 0603 to 2225, 25 V to 6 kV and 250 VAC safety

source.revision: Huiju (Nanjing) MLCC product handbook, no revision given

summary: A family of surface-mount multilayer ceramic capacitors in C0G (±30 ppm/℃) and X7R (±15%) dielectrics, EIA sizes 0603 to 2225, all rated -55°C to +125°C with lead-free Cu or Ag / Ni / Sn terminations. Twelve series codes split the range by voltage (NL to 50 V, NM 100-630 V, NV 1-3 kV, NH above 3 kV), by purpose (NC high capacitance, ND low loss, OP open-mode electrodes, AB soft termination, IR industrial, AN AEC-Q200 automotive) and by safety class (SX X2, SY X1/Y2 at 250 VAC). A capacitance table per series gives the thickness code of every offered value, size and voltage.
key_figures: 25 V to 6 kV DC; 250 VAC safety

operation.text: Stacked inner electrodes in a ceramic body end in terminations of Ni over the base metal with a Sn outer layer. In the standard design the termination width exceeds the inner-electrode margin; in the open-mode design the margin is wider than the termination.
Lead- and cadmium-free general-purpose parts for input and output filtering of supplies, snubbers, power-factor correction and noise bypass. NL covers up to 50 V; NM covers 100 V to 630 V.

High-voltage parts built from capacitor sections connected in series inside the chip. Listed uses are DC-DC converters, high-voltage coupling and DC blocking, backlight inverters, LAN/WLAN links and modems. NV covers 1 kV to 3 kV, NH above 3 kV to 6 kV.
High capacitance in a given case size, for high-frequency dense power supplies, coupling, decoupling, bypass and filtering.
Low-loss ceramic giving low ESR and dissipation; listed for camera touch, digital telecom, audio and lighting circuits.

A special inner-electrode print pattern splits the voltage to lessen surge stress and keeps a board-flex crack from forming a current path. Listed for high-current loops and parts exposed to mechanical stress.
A flexible conductive resin layer between the ceramic and the outer termination soaks up board-bending and thermal-shock stress. Listed for boards under mechanical stress, thermal shock or drop risk.
Industrial-grade parts screened by thermal shock and dual 85°C/85%RH bias humidity qualification per MIL-PRF-55681.
Automotive-grade process meeting AEC-Q200, low ESR and ESL, for navigation, infotainment, body electronics and new-energy vehicle electronics.

Safety-certified capacitors (CQC, TUV, UL) to IEC60384-14, UL60384-14 and UL60950, intended for surge and lightning protection in modems, fax and telephone circuits, lighting and isolation. SY parts are X1/Y2 rated; SX parts are X2.
Production is certified to GJB/9000 and IATF16949.
